title: VILBORG room darkening curtains
description: VILBORG room darkening curtains, 1 pair, pink/with heading tape, 57x98" VILBORG room darkening curtains in soft pink with elegant linear texture. The durable, easy-care fabric insulates and darkens the room without feeling bulky. Multi-way header for different hanging options.
features: The curtains are sold in pairs. The sizes stated refer to each single curtain. For the total width, double the width of a single curtain.
The material in this product may be recyclable. Please check the recycling rules in your community and if recycling facilities exist in your area.
16 gliders and hooks are usually recommended for each curtain with a width of 57⅛". You can increase or decrease the number depending on whether you want narrower or fuller folds in the pleats.
